name: adapt_role_list_ruby_dynamic
description: Dynamic eval: allowed_roles.txt (a spec file the role check must match) is REWRITTEN between prompts (fixed after_prompt trigger); the agent must re-read it live, not bake the old list into roles.rb
prompts: Create roles.rb with a method is_allowed?(role) that returns true if role is in the comma-separated list in allowed_roles.txt (currently: admin, editor), else false. Read the list from the file (File.read) at call time - do not hardcode it.
allowed_roles.txt has changed. Make sure is_allowed? reflects the CURRENT list in the file.

disruptions.description: allowed_roles.txt rewritten to add a new role

test_setup_files.roles_hidden_test.rb:
require_relative "roles"

allowed = File.read("allowed_roles.txt").strip.split(",").map(&:strip)
allowed.each do |role|
  raise "is_allowed?(#{role}) should be true" unless is_allowed?(role)
end
raise "is_allowed? should reject an unknown role" if is_allowed?("not_a_real_role")
puts "all tests passed"
